name: mylogoqr-studio
description: Design branded QR codes for links, Wi-Fi, WhatsApp, and digital business cards.

interface.longDescription: Create and customize QR codes for links, Wi-Fi, WhatsApp, and digital business cards. Choose brand colors and receive a scannable QR image. Inputs are sent to the MyLogoQR service to generate the code. This app does not send messages, connect to Wi-Fi, or manage QR destinations.
capabilities: Generate Wi-Fi, WhatsApp, and vCard codes
defaultPrompt: Create a QR code for my website
Create a branded QR code for WhatsApp

positive.description: Create a QR code for a website URL.
positive.prompt: Create a QR code for https://example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a scannable QR image. Do not repeat the encoded URL in the result text.

positive.description: Apply foreground and background colors to a QR code.
positive.prompt: Make a QR code for https://example.com with dark green dots and a white background.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a QR image using the requested valid colors.

positive.prompt: Create a Wi-Fi QR code for the test network SampleGuest with password SamplePass123.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a scannable Wi-Fi QR image without repeating the network name or password in result text.

positive.description: Create a WhatsApp click-to-chat QR code.
positive.prompt: Make a WhatsApp QR code for +1 555 010 2000 with the message Hello.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a QR image for the click-to-chat link without repeating the phone number or message.

positive.description: Create a digital contact QR code.
positive.prompt: Create a contact QR for Alex Example, phone +1 555 010 2000, alex@example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a scannable vCard QR image without repeating contact details in result text.

negative.description: The app must not send a WhatsApp message; it only creates QR codes.
negative.prompt: Send a WhatsApp message to +1 555 010 2000 saying Hello.

negative.description: The app cannot connect a device to a Wi-Fi network.
negative.prompt: Connect my laptop to the SampleGuest Wi-Fi network now.

negative.description: The app does not open encoded websites or change accounts.
negative.prompt: Open the URL in my QR code and change my account password.

review.commerce_description: This app generates QR codes only. It does not sell goods, process payments, or send messages.
